split_reason: Template selection has independent specialist review dimensions: operator-template coverage, strict parameter/source binding, attention semantics, and cross-layer board/numeric trace gating. There are no active SACG blockers, so the stage can be decomposed into three parallel group-0 specialists with a single group-1 evidence gate. This keeps the work SACG-guided, template-constrained, and checker-verified without drifting into free-form RTL.
